prompt: If I was teaching about the Atlantic Slavs trade, provide 5 topics to discuss about the impact it made on the economy
judge_reasoning: Candidate 1 directly provides five discussion topics specifically about the economic impact of the Atlantic slave trade (e.g., wealth generation, global commerce, effects on Africa, plantation economies, and modern economic legacy). Candidate 2 is almost entirely about cultural impacts (syncretism, identity, resilience) and does not address economy, so it strongly misses the prompt. Candidate 3 focuses on demographic/genetic impacts and includes highly specific quantitative claims that are not clearly substantiated, further compounding the off-topic nature. Candidate 4 includes some economic themes (economic growth, profits, industrial advancement) but is primarily organized around European participants and political power rather than clearly delivering five economy-impact topics, making it only partially aligned.
